# SilverSea 0.1.9

This update fixes a startup issue that could make SilverSea open as a black window on some Windows PCs. It also keeps the app's graphics acceleration on its normal Electron settings.

## Install or update

Download **SilverSea-Setup.exe** below and run it. Your library and settings are kept when you install a newer version.
